Package backend.classes

Class CartCard

java.lang.Object
backend.classes.CartCard
public class CartCard extends Object
Represents an item in the order panel's cart.

A CartCard stores a drink’s base information, customizations (ice level, sweetness, toppings), and quantity. It also provides utility methods for calculating prices and comparing items for combination in the order cart.

Used in OrderPanelController to display and manage items currently in the user's order.
